existing_features.title: Enable the in-game Admin section for all joined players by adjusting the admin gating so that any authenticated user who has joined the game can access all `/admin/*` routes without seeing an access-denied screen.

Enable the Admin "Grant TRP Coins" UI so that it is usable (inputs and button enabled) and wired to the backend TRP coin grant method; on success it shows a confirmation toast, and on error it shows the backend error message.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add an in-game 'Admin' section and grant all joined players admin privileges, including ability to add unlimited TRP coins and perform any admin actions

Change authorization so that every player who has joined the game (i.e., has a saved user profile / has #user permission) is treated as an admin for permission checks and for `isCallerAdmin()` / `getCallerUserRole()` responses.

Implement backend functionality to allow admins to grant an arbitrary (unlimited) amount of TRP coins to any specified user principal, updating that user's `UserProfile.balance` accordingly and returning a success result or an explicit error if the user does not exist.

projectName: Grant admin access to all joined players and enable unlimited TRP coin admin tools
